Fact: eval_results
What to find: Benchmark evaluation results (benchmark, metric, score).
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Benchmarks, Results

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card reports benchmark results for Llama 4 Scout (instruction tuned), among other models. Examples: MMLU Pro (0-shot, macro_avg/acc) 74.3; GPQA Diamond (0-shot, accuracy) 57.2. The card also reports results for other benchmarks. Its tables cover pre-trained and instruction-tuned models, and cover image, coding, multilingual and long-context tasks. All reported evaluations were run on bf16 models.
quotes: all reported evaluations and testing were conducted on bf16 models
